name: Foseco India Limited
summary: Foseco India Limited engages in manufacturing of additives and consumables for the metallurgical industry in India and internationally. It offers feeder sleeves and risers, coatings for sand molds and cores, filters and gating systems, metal treatment for nonferrous alloys, crucibles and retorts, binders and molding materials, and ferrous metal treatment, as well as melt shop refractories and flow control and die coatings for permanent mold die casting. The company also provides foundry services, such as advice, practice magazines, white papers, training and support, and technical services, including analytical services and casting simulation support.
